sanskrit_verse:
आ जन्मनश् चामरणात् सुकृतं यत् त्वयार्जितम् ।
तत् सर्वं नाशमायाति वितथस्याभिशंसनात् ॥
transliteration: ā janmanaś cā maraṇāt sukṛtaṃ yat tvayārjitam | tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāti vitathasyābhiśaṃsanāt ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Whatever merit accrued through virtuous action from birth to death becomes nullified when one utters falsehood under false pretense.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation arises from integrity of declaration
Capacity-based responsibility is forfeited through deliberate falsification
Restoration logic requires re-alignment with ontological truth
Consciousness alignment depends on truthful assertion
executable_legal_axioms: IF a speaker knowingly declares a falsehood THEN all accumulated dharma-credit is annulled
IF an agent falsifies intent in speech THEN no restorative benefit accrues from prior acts
IF testimony contains deliberate misrepresentation THEN legal standing is suspended until realignment
IF dharma-debt exists due to false assertion THEN completion process must restore causal congruence
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, any witness or litigant found to have deliberately misrepresented facts invalidates their entire record of merit-based standing. The court shall initiate restoration protocols before proceeding further.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that untruthful speech disrupts the sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of karmic consequence. Responsibility is proportional to awareness of falseness. No punitive measure applies; only realignment with satya restores capacity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Truth-Reclamation Process wherein declarer revisits each false utterance
Implement Consciousness Alignment Protocol to reconnect speaker with causal integrity
Execute Merit-Reconstruction Sequence upon full acknowledgment and withdrawal of falsehood
Assign Completion Ritual requiring public affirmation of veracity before societal reintegration
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Falsehood uttered without alignment with inner knowing dissolves all accumulated virtue. Dharma is restored through conscious realignment alone. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
